## Next.js Website Architecture Audit: josephibrahim.com

### 1. LAYOUT STRUCTURE

#### Root Layout
- **File**: `/app/layout.tsx`
- **Summary**: Root layout with global font configuration, metadata setup, navigation/footer wrappers, and perception context initialization
- **Key Features**:
  - 4 Google Fonts loaded (Inter, DM_Sans, Open_Sans, Lora) with optimized weights and `display: swap`
  - Preconnect/DNS prefetch links to Vimeo CDN for video performance (saves 300-500ms)
  - Structured schema.org JSON-LD markup for SEO
  - **Skip link for keyboard navigation** (sr-only with focus:not-sr-only pattern for accessibility)
  - View Transitions wrapper for cinematic page crossfades
  - Perception context provider for visitor archetype detection

#### Page Files (All Client Components)
- `/app/page.tsx` — Homepage with hero reel, scroll-driven animations, and ladder grid
- `/app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx` — Dynamic project detail pages with hero reel and content wrapper
- `/app/process/page.tsx` — Process/resources with accordion-style category reveals
- `/app/photo/page.tsx` — Photography gallery
- `/app/gen-ai/page.tsx` — AI-related work showcase
- `/app/info/page.tsx` — About/bio page
- `/app/og-preview/page.tsx`, `/app/og-vfx-frame/page.tsx` — Open Graph preview pages
- Dynamic OG image generators at `/app/process/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx` and `/app/projects/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx`

---

### 2. COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE

#### Navigation & UI Shell
- **Navigation.tsx** — Fixed navbar with:
  - Responsive logo sizing (19px→22px with clamp)
  - Double-click detection for Easter Egg (Tools overlay)
  - Scroll-synchronized background opacity fade (matches hero reel calculations)
  - Mobile hamburger menu (44px minimum touch targets)
  - Desktop nav with aria-current for accessibility
  - Dynamic styling based on hero reel presence

- **Footer.tsx** — Fixed footer with:
  - Color hierarchy (email/location PRIMARY, labels TERTIARY)
  - Social icon links (LinkedIn, Instagram, Vimeo)
  - Fibonacci spacing (var(--space-sm), var(--space-md))
  - View transition name for seamless crossfades

#### Video Components
- **HeroReel.tsx** — Homepage hero video:
  - Auto-plays on desktop, static thumbnail on mobile
  - 12-second initialization timeout with graceful fallback
  - Scroll-driven opacity fade with progress tracking
  - Pause/resume on scroll with ref-based state tracking
  - Filter desaturation on initial reveal

- **VideoThumbnail.tsx** — Hover-to-play thumbnails:
  - Robust initialization with AbortController for cancellation
  - Single-video enforcement via VideoThumbnailManager
  - Touch device detection (no video on mobile/coarse pointer)
  - Light table effect: 60% opacity → 100% on hover
  - Cinematic aspect ratio support (16:9 or 2.39:1)

- **ProjectHeroReel.tsx** — Project detail hero video (similar to HeroReel with 30% fade start)

- **EmbeddedVideoPlayer.tsx** — Inline video player for detail content

#### Grid & Layout Components
- **LadderGrid.tsx** — Two-column staggered project grid:
  - Golden ratio spacing (89px row/column gaps, 144px card gaps)
  - Scroll-animated cards using RAF with `contentVisibility: auto`
  - Cubic ease-out animation (fade-up from 24px translateY)
  - Scroll-up reversal detection from page bottom
  - ResponsiveLayout with Fibonacci percentages (38.2% offset on right column)

- **ProjectCard.tsx** — Individual project card:
  - Title + description + client hierarchy
  - Color-coded text (primary title, secondary description, dim client)
  - Hover opacity transition (0.6 dim factor)
  - Always-visible title (scan-friendly design)

- **ProjectGrid.tsx** — Alternative grid layout

#### Text & Animation Components
- **RotatingTitle.tsx** — Cycling title display:
  - 4-second dwell + 0.5-second fade per title
  - aria-live polite for screen reader announcements
  - Prevents layout shift with minHeight

- **RotatingRole.tsx** — Similar rotating component (role/archetype indicator)

- **ScrollReveal.tsx** — Intersection observer-based reveal:
  - 400ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1) fade-up
  - 15px translateY lift
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion

- **ChatTypingIndicator.tsx** — Animated three-dot indicator for chatbot

#### Interactive & State Components
- **ChatBot.tsx** — AI assistant overlay:
  - Message streaming with typing indicator
  - Project card embedding in chat responses
  - Quick-reply suggestions (contextual suggestions rotate)
  - Input focus management (auto-focus on open)
  - Escape key handling (aria-modal implied)
  - Read-time calculation for response pacing

- **ToolsOverlay.tsx** — Easter Egg overlay for tools/downloads (double-click nav chat icon)

- **FilterBar.tsx** — Category/filter controls for grid

- **SearchBar.tsx** — Search functionality

- **AccordionCategory.tsx** — Expandable accordion for Process page:
  - Cascading toggle behavior (closing opens next)
  - Sticky expansion on desktop

- **ProcessThumbnail.tsx** — Process item card with metadata

#### Perception & Analytics
- **PerceptionLayer.tsx** — Context wrapper:
  - Initializes PerceptionProvider for visitor archetype detection
  - Bridges sensor event recording to components

- **PerceptionSensor.tsx** — Background event listener:
  - Records browsing patterns (clicks, scrolls, time-on-page)
  - Feeds into classifier for archetype inference

- **PerceptionIndicator.tsx** — Debug indicator (visible when ?debug=perception)

#### Infrastructure
- **ViewTransitions.tsx** — Client-side router wrapper:
  - Intercepts internal link clicks
  - Triggers View Transitions API if available
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion
  - Handles external/hash/download links gracefully

- **ScrollReset.tsx** — Resets scroll position on page load

- **DeferredOverlays.tsx** — Portal-style overlay container

- **CustomCursor.tsx** — Custom cursor styling

- **VideoThumbnailManager.tsx** — Global context for managing single active video

---

### 3. GLOBAL CSS & DESIGN TOKENS

**File**: `/app/globals.css`

#### Design System
- **Spacing**: Fibonacci scale (21, 34, 55, 89, 144, 233px)
- **Colors**:
  - Background: `#141414`
  - Text primary: `#e8e8e8` (titles, headings)
  - Text secondary: `#7a7a7a` (body, descriptions)
  - Text dim: `#5a5a5a` (metadata, labels)
  - Accent: `#d4a853` (warm gold)
  - Greys: 9-step scale (grey-50 to grey-900)

- **Typography**:
  - Display/body: Inter (neo-grotesque, clean)
  - Editorial: Lora italic (serif accent for quotes)
  - Body variants: Open Sans (light/regular)
  - DM Sans (medium weight option)

- **Border Radius**: 3 values only (4px, 6px, 50%)

- **Transitions**: Fast (200ms), base (300ms), smooth (400ms cubic-bezier)

#### Animations (in globals.css)
- `fadeUp` — 0.7s cubic-out, staggered delays (0-400ms)
- `fadeIn` — 0.8s ease-out
- `scrollFloat` — Infinite chevron bob animation (2.8s ease-in-out)
- `typingPulse` — Three-dot breathing animation
- `chatMessageIn` — Chat message entrance (0.3s fade-up)
- **View Transitions**: 
  - Content: `fade-and-scale-in/out` (500ms ease-in-out with micro-scale)
  - Navigation/footer: Fade-only (400ms, no scale to stay anchored)

#### Accessibility in CSS
- `:focus` removed, `:focus-visible` adds 2px white outline with 2px offset
- Button/link focus-visible overrides for clarity
- **Reduced motion** media query disables all animations/transitions
- Skip link: `.sr-only` (screen-reader-only) with `focus:not-sr-only` pattern

#### Hover States
- `.nav-link` — Dims to 60% opacity on hover
- `.section-header-highlight` — 50% default, 100% on hover
- `.button-arrow` — Shifts right 4px + opacity lift on hover

---

### 4. ANIMATION & MOTION PATTERNS

#### Scroll-Driven Animations
- **HeroReel fade**: Opacity controlled by scroll progress (synchronized with nav background)
- **LadderGrid scroll reveal**: Cards fade-up as they enter viewport, lock at max progress achieved
- **Intro text fade**: Fades out as scroll reaches 600-800px threshold
- **Gradient overlay**: Fades in as content scrolls behind navigation

#### Entrance Animations
- **Hero statement**: 550ms cubic-bezier fade-up + translateY(20-30px)
- **Project cards**: 0.7s fadeUp with nth-child staggered delays
- **Scroll indicator chevron**: 2.8s infinite float animation

#### View Transitions API
- Intercepts internal navigation clicks
- Cinematic crossfade: old page scales out 0.98, new page scales in 1.02
- Navigation only fades (no scale) to stay anchored
- Disabled for external/hash/download links
- Graceful fallback for unsupported browsers

#### Reduced Motion Handling
- All animations/transitions set to 0.01ms duration
- Transform and animation properties removed
- aria-live regions exempt (transitions: none)
- Scroll behavior becomes instant (not smooth)

---

### 5. FORM ELEMENTS & INTERACTIVE CONTROLS

#### ChatBot Input
- Single `<input>` field in ChatBot.tsx with:
  - Auto-focus on open (100ms delay)
  - Escape key handler to close modal
  - Real-time message state updates
  - Streaming response handling with AbortController

#### Quick-Reply Buttons
- Dynamic suggestion buttons in ChatBot
- Initial: generic questions
- Follow-up: contextual suggestions after conversation

#### Navigation Buttons
- Logo (link to home)
- Nav links (Work, Photo, Process, About)
- Mobile hamburger button (44px touch target)
- Chat icon button (44px touch target, double-click Easter Egg)

#### Process Page Controls
- AccordionCategory headers (tap/hover to expand)
- Cascading toggle behavior (closing one opens next)
- FilterBar for category selection

#### Video Controls
- Hover-to-play on thumbnails (desktop only)
- Touch devices: static thumbnail only
- Video player muted/looped with no UI controls

---

### 6. FONT LOADING CONFIGURATION

**File**: `/app/layout.tsx`

```typescript
// 4 fonts optimized for weight subset:
- Inter: weights 400, 500, 600 (nav, headings, display)
- DM_Sans: weights 400, 500 (secondary option)
- Open_Sans: weights 300, 400 (light body text)
- Lora: weight 400 in normal + italic (editorial quotes)

// All use:
- subsets: ["latin"]
- display: "swap" (font swaps immediately, updates when loaded)
- variable: CSS custom properties (--font-inter, --font-dm-sans, etc.)
```

CSS variables injected to `<html>` class:
```html
<html className={`${inter.variable} ${openSans.variable} ${lora.variable} ${dmSans.variable}`}>
```

Fonts mapped in globals.css:
```css
--font-display: var(--font-inter), 'Inter', sans-serif;
--font-body: var(--font-inter), 'Inter', sans-serif;
```

---

### 7. IMAGE COMPONENTS & HANDLING

#### Static Images
- **Vimeo Thumbnails**: `https://vumbnail.com/{videoId}.jpg` (fallback)
- **Custom Thumbnails**: Project-specific thumbnail URLs in project config
- **OG Images**: Static `/og-image.png` for social sharing

#### Image Optimization Patterns
- **Preload critical OG image**: `<link rel="preload" href="...og-image.jpg" as="image" />`
- **Background images**: CSS `backgroundImage` property on div elements
- **Thumbnail loading**: 
  - Always-visible static thumbnail at 60% opacity
  - Video layer fades in on hover (responsive aspect ratio handling)

#### Image Sizing
- Aspect ratios: `16/9` (standard), `2.39/1` (cinematic)
- Dynamic size with clamp: e.g., `clamp(22px, 2.2vw, 28px)` for responsive scaling
- Covers set via CSS `backgroundSize: cover`, `backgroundPosition: center`

#### Image Accessibility
- Vimeo player iframe has `title` suppressed (background video)
- OG images have alt text in metadata
- Hero reel preload reduces visual lag

---

### 8. NAVIGATION COMPONENT(S)

**File**: `/components/Navigation.tsx`

#### Structure
- **Fixed positioning** at top (z-index 100)
- **Responsive layout**:
  - Desktop: Logo left, nav links center, chat icon right (baseline-aligned)
  - Mobile: Logo left, chat + hamburger right (flex-end)

#### Features
- **Scroll-linked opacity fade**: Background transitions from transparent to opaque as hero video fades
- **Active state tracking**: `aria-current="page"` for semantic active links
- **Mobile menu**: Full-screen overlay with large touch targets (44px min)
- **Double-click detection**: Single click opens chatbot; double-click opens Tools overlay
- **Dynamic text color**: Uses CSS variable `var(--text-primary)`

#### Responsive Sizing
- Logo: `clamp(19px, 0.5vw + 15px, 22px)`
- Nav links: `clamp(18px, 0.5vw + 14px, 21px)`
- Mobile menu: `clamp(36px, 10vw, 72px)`
- Letter-spacing: 0.10em–0.16em (uppercase tracking)

#### Accessibility
- Keyboard navigation with nav links
- Mobile menu close button (44px)
- aria-label on icon buttons ("Ask about Joe", "Open menu")
- Escape key closes mobile menu
- Route-aware: closes menu when URL changes

---

### 9. ACCESSIBILITY PATTERNS

#### Skip Links
- **Skip to main content** link at top of layout.tsx
- `.sr-only` (screen reader only)
- `focus:not-sr-only` reveals on keyboard focus with white outline
- Links to `#main-content` anchor on main element

#### ARIA Attributes
- **Navigation**: `aria-current="page"` on active links
- **RotatingTitle**: `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` for dynamic text updates
- **ChatBot**: Implied modal (overlay behavior, input focus trap)
- **Chat buttons**: `aria-label="Ask about Joe"`, `aria-label="Open menu"`
- **Icon buttons**: Descriptive aria-labels

#### Focus Management
- **ChatBot**: Auto-focuses input on open (with timeout)
- **Mobile menu**: Close button, link focus trap implicit
- **Focus indicators**: 2px white outline on :focus-visible with 2px offset
- **Mouse-click focus removed**: `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` removes outline

#### Motion & Vestibular Accessibility
- **prefers-reduced-motion media query**: Disables all animations/transitions
- **Scroll behavior**: Respects `scroll-behavior: smooth` preference
- **Animations disabled**: All keyframes become 0.01ms when reducing motion
- **View Transitions**: Respects reduced-motion (disables transition)

#### Touch & Pointer Accessibility
- **44px minimum touch targets**: All buttons/interactive elements
- **Touch device detection**: 
  - `useIsTouchDevice()` hook: `window.matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)')`
  - Mobile videos show static thumbnail (no hover effects)
- **Hover media query**: `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` gates hover-only styles

#### Color & Contrast
- **Color hierarchy semantic**: Dark text on dark background requires sufficient contrast
- **Accent gold (#d4a853)**: Warm tone, distinct from greys
- **Grey scale**: 9 steps for information hierarchy
- **Disabled state**: Opacity reduction (not color alone)

#### Semantic HTML
- `<nav>` for navigation
- `<footer>` for footer (view transition name)
- `<main id="main-content">` for main content
- `<article>` for project detail
- `<section>` for grouped content
- `<a>` for navigation, `<button>` for actions

---

### 10. ADDITIONAL ARCHITECTURAL PATTERNS

#### Perception System (Visitor Archetype Detection)
- **PerceptionLayer**: Context provider wrapper
- **PerceptionSensor**: Background event listener
- **PerceptionContext**: Stores archetype, confidence, event history
- **Use case**: Adapts project grid order based on visitor interests (only when confidence > 0.5)

#### State Management
- **React Hooks**: useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useTransition
- **No external state library**: Local component state + context for perception
- **Ref tracking**: Used for scroll tracking, player initialization, polling

#### Performance Optimizations
- **contentVisibility: auto** on LadderGrid cards (skips paint/layout for off-screen items)
- **containIntrinsicSize** for size hints
- **willChange**: Hint on GPU-accelerated elements
- **Passive event listeners**: `{ passive: true }` on all scroll/resize handlers
- **AbortController**: Cancels pending operations (video initialization, API calls)
- **RequestAnimationFrame**: Batches scroll-driven DOM updates

#### Dynamic Imports
- **ChatBot**: `dynamic(() => import('./ChatBot'), { ssr: false })`
- **ToolsOverlay**: `dynamic(() => import('./ToolsOverlay'), { ssr: false })`

#### API Integration
- **AI Chat**: `/app/api/ai-chat/route.ts` (streaming responses)
- **Vimeo Player**: Dynamic import of @vimeo/player library
- **Perception logging**: Async event recording (non-blocking)

---

### SUMMARY OF KEY ARCHITECTURE DECISIONS

1. **Golden Ratio Design**: Fibonacci spacing (21, 34, 55, 89, 144, 233px) throughout
2. **Dark Theme with Warm Accent**: #141414 background, #d4a853 gold accent
3. **Scroll-Driven Animations**: No JavaScript animations; scroll position drives opacity/transforms
4. **Video-First Interaction**: Hover-to-play on desktop, static thumbnails on mobile
5. **Perception Context**: Visitor archetype detection for personalized content ordering
6. **View Transitions API**: Cinematic page crossfades with fallback
7. **Accessibility-First**: Skip links, focus management, reduced-motion compliance, 44px touch targets
8. **Font Optimization**: 4 fonts with minimal weights, display: swap for fast rendering
9. **Responsive Clamp Scaling**: Fluid typography and spacing (no breakpoint jumps)
10. **Component Encapsulation**: Each component handles its own state, animations, and accessibility
